narrative: Material PL1__ME8381E8 exhibits moderate daily demand variability (CV=0.24, mean=15,272 units/day) with no statistically significant trend over the 180-day observation window. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=0.88), with transport variability driving 93.84% of total supply chain uncertainty, requiring a substantially higher safety stock than currently configured in SAP. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ-derived order quantity of 30,486 units and reorder point of 60,841 units is recommended to achieve the 95% service level target.
warnings: Current SAP safety stock (9,903) is 63.2% below the analytically derived requirement (26,898); stockout risk is elevated under current ERP settings.
Lead time CV=0.88 classified as unstable; transport reliability improvement would materially reduce required safety stock.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Material has near-continuous non-zero demand (99.4% active days) with moderate CV, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy optimal. The EOQ naturally exceeds MOQ, eliminating lot-size tension. No trend or seasonality requiring (s,S) or base-stock models was detected.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is non-binding: peak inventory of ~57,384 units occupies only 18.5% of the 310,579-unit limit. No capacity-driven order quantity reduction required.
